'''2009 Worlds Team Tournament Hank Mardukas LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Hank Mardukas]] at [[2009 World Championship]] (Team Tournament).

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This]]
* '''Username:''' rotwin31b
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
